chapter_title: The Interpretation of Happiness, Wisdom and Power; what they signify.
chapter_note: The chapter contains a strong cosmological five-fold mapping of “happiness/wisdom/power” across divinities and cosmic stations (core) wrapped in a minimal opening frame. A clear editorial seam extends the pattern into ecclesial/institutional identifications (paragraph 9), matching the pastoral drift signal. The concluding summary (paragraph 10) likely belongs to the same teaching layer as the five-fold schema and is retained as core despite its blessing formula.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic hagiographic opening: the enlightener speaking to disciples in the church assembly.
Introductory rhetorical question contrasting ‘worldly’ meanings; functions as setup rather than systematic cosmological exposition; no core structuring yet.
Transitional editorial voice (“as I have told you”) without cosmological mapping; reads as continuation of the setup.

paragraphs.core_text: [I will t]each you of another happiness [ ... ] and another wi]sdom [ ... ] and together another power [ ... ] So, now, listen that I may reveal to you [how] it is [with] these three: [ha]ppiness, wisdom and power.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Programmatic shift into impersonal teaching mode: announces the interpretive schema for the triad.

paragraphs.core_text: [The happin]ess of the glorious one is the Father, the God of [truth, who] is established in the great land of [light]. ⟨p.24⟩ His glorious wis[d]om is his Great Spirit that [ ... ] below, which flows through all his aeons, and t[h]ey float therein. His great power is all the gods, the rich ones and the angels who were summoned from him as they [ ... ] t]hey that are called aeons [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic triad-identification at the highest cosmic level (Father/land of light) with named beings; expository cosmological register marks core.

paragraphs.core_text: [ ... ] which is called] the sun [ ... the ship of] living fire, [ ... the Third Amba]ssador, the second greatne[ss ... The] glorious [happiness] is the [Living] Spirit, [ ... , the wisdom] is the Mother of Lif[e ... and great power] is [all] the gods, [the] rich o]nes and the angels who are within the ship.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the structured mapping into a new cosmic station (sun/ship of living fire) with standard Manichaean divine names.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, [h]appiness, wisdom and power exist in the s[hip of liv]ing waters [ ... ] the happiness [ ... ] the Mind of the Father. Also, wisdom [is the Vir]gi]n of [Li]ght. And the power that is [i]n the ship is [all] the go[ds], the [ri]ch ones and the angels who are established i[n it].
paragraphs.temporal_note: Iterative “Again…” sequence mapping the triad to the moon/ship of living waters; systematic, non-citation exposition.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, these three exist in the elements: happiness, wis[d]o]m and power. The happiness is [the Pillar of Glory], the Perfect Man. Wisdom is the [five sons of the] Living Spirit; and great powe[r is ... the fi]ve sons of the First Man [ ... who are encl]osed and compounded in the totality, that [ ... ] while he supports the totality.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Highly diagnostic core: triad mapped into elements with numbered groupings (‘five sons’), cosmic mechanics, and systematic correspondences.

Editorial seam: bridge ‘Now, moreover’ extends the prior cosmological iteration into institutional church identifications (apostle of light, leaders/teachers, elect/catechumens). Entire paragraph is an editorial graft.

paragraphs.core_text: [ ... ] five happinesses, the five wisdoms, [a]nd five powers [ ... ] in the five chur[ches]. Blessed, [therefore], is every one who will know them, for he may [ ... ] the kingdom forever.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Summative closure of the five-fold schema (‘five happinesses… five wisdoms… five powers’). Though it includes a beatitude-like line, it functions as the capstone of the systematic fivefold teaching rather than institutional regulation or NT citation.
